description: Registration configuration (walk-in identifier format, default facility, attendance rule).

fields.label: Search by Identifier First on New Patient
fields.description: A new Patient form opens with a 'Find patient by identifier' dialog before any details are captured (FR-1, FR-2).

fields.label: Walk-in Identifier Format
fields.description: Placeholders: {facility_code}, {YYYY}, {YY}, {MM}, and one run of # for the sequence, e.g. {#####}. The counter restarts for every distinct prefix. Format pending OI-13.

fields.label: Default Registration Facility
fields.description: Used when neither the patient nor the user's default sets a facility.

fields.label: Similarity Candidate Limit
fields.description: How many records matching one name sound are scored, newest first. Exact matches on both names, or on one name with the same date of birth and sex, are always scored.

fields.label: Attendance Year
fields.description: A visit is a New attendance when it is the patient's first visit to the facility in this year; later visits are Re-attendances. Visits closed as Registered in error or Superseded are not counted.

fields.label: Allow Reception Attendance Override
fields.description: The Nurse Receptionist may mark a visit as a Re-attendance (Seen here before in SmartCare, or Correct Attendance while the visit is Registered). The HIS Officer can always correct attendance.

fields.label: Seed Version
fields.description: Internal: version of the one-off seed updates applied by install.

name: EMR Registration Settings
